query: SELECT notice_type,notice_type_new,count(*) AS documents,count(*) FILTER(WHERE content IS NULL) AS null_content,count(*) FILTER(WHERE content IS NOT NULL) AS content_present FROM public.news_notice WHERE pub_time >= %s AND pub_time < %s GROUP BY notice_type,notice_type_new ORDER BY count(*) DESC,notice_type_new,notice_type
limits: Exact date-bounded source rows, not unique issuer events. null_content is SQL NULL only; content_present does not prove usable/full body. Type names remain unverified.

all_history_type_inventory.query: SELECT DISTINCT notice_type_new FROM public.news_notice WHERE notice_type_new IS NOT NULL ORDER BY notice_type_new
all_history_type_inventory.additional_type_query: SELECT id,title,pub_time,url,notice_type,notice_type_new FROM public.news_notice WHERE notice_type_new=1030302 ORDER BY pub_time,id,url
